meta.landmarks: MediaPipe face mesh, indices 0-467 (iris points 468-477 unused)
meta.units: displacement in face units: 1 = distance between outer eye corners (landmarks 33, 263)
meta.axes: x along the eye-corner line towards landmark 263 (image right for a frontal face); y perpendicular to it, pointing down
meta.amplitude: field values are at amplitude +1; negative amplitudes mirror the motion; fields add linearly
meta.apply: dst_px[i] = L_px[i] + a * (dx * ex + dy * ey) * unit, with ex, ey, unit from the face's own eye corners (see aurc/face.py)
